rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical prize won in a competition.

example.english: The prize in this competition is a new phone.
example.traditional: 呢次比賽嘅獎品係一部新手機。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ge3 zoeng2 ban2 hai6 jat1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the prize is money.

example.english: The champion can receive a five-thousand-dollar prize.
example.traditional: 冠軍可以攞到五千蚊獎金。
example.jyutping: gun3 gwan1 ho2 ji5 lo2 dou2 ng5 cin1 man1 zoeng2 gam1

rows.note: Use this for an award or prize category, especially when discussing ceremonies or results.

example.english: There are many prize categories at the awards ceremony tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚頒獎禮有好多獎項。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 baan1 zoeng2 lai5 jau5 hou2 do1 zoeng2 hong6

rows.note: Use this shorter generic noun when the type of award or prize is clear from context.

example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou2 go3 zoeng2
